root_text:
So while my hMPV acute symptoms have passed, welcome to 8 weeks of weird lingering symptoms, and crushing post-viral fatigue. The joys of being #longcovid immunocompromised 😵‍💫😖

Stay safe out there Australia. Wear a mask. Get your booster.
